description: §8.1.2 (S456) — control for the one-statement rule: a single statement with a trailing `;` followed by a comment, a `;` inside a string literal, and two writes split into two `?{}`s inside a `transaction { }` block all compile clean. (S479, g-conf-transaction-cases-stale-s478: `record` is declared `! -> SqlError` — §19.10.4: "`transaction { }` SHALL be valid only inside `!` functions" — ends `return 1;` (§7.2.2 rule 1), and its handler call is handled, `record() !{ _ :> 0 }` (§19.4.3: a call to a `!` function SHALL NOT be ignored).)
rationale: §8.1.2: a `;` that is followed only by whitespace and comments ends the one statement; a `;` inside a literal, comment, quoted identifier or `${…}` slot is not a separator. The fix the diagnostic names (one `?{}` per statement; `transaction { }` for atomicity) compiles.
